digest.component_or_area: completion-verification close gate / LLM agent runaway guard
propositions: Memo-served (cached) file reads are incorrectly counted as loop evidence by the outermost runaway guard, causing RunawayToolLoopError to abort legitimate completion verification despite the guard sitting before the memo layer in composition order

The runaway guard must distinguish between executed tool calls and memo-served (free) cache hits; a shared ToolCallLedger tracks both to allow the distinct-ratio arm to evaluate only executed work, not model chatter
A served-streak backstop arm must still bound pure cache-served loops after a full window of zero-execution calls, preventing infinite loops despite all calls being memo-served

Reads past the cached window fall back to uncached exact-range reads, degrading the distinct-ratio metric further; the solution records such fallback reads as executed work into the ledger to correctly account for them
The layer composition must remain Guard→Memo→Steering with completion-policy visibility unchanged, so the fix recomposes via shared ledger rather than reordering layers

Five execution-recording sites inside the memo layer (non-allowlisted passthrough, exact-signature cache miss, unparseable path, whole-file first-read, truncated-window fallback) must each reset the served-streak when they execute real work
